items.title: Bangladesh eyes debut sovereign bond in three months
items.description: The government plans to issue a sovereign bond for the first time within the next three months, seeking to diversify its sources of financing, Tanvir Shahriar Ghani, special assistant to the prime minister, said today.

items.title: Govt eyes new IMF programme by February: finance minister
items.description: The government expects to enter a new programme with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) by February next year, Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury said today.
